6:Teb3c,<p>Svelte와 Vue를 사용하면서 느낀 차이점을 이야기해 보려고 합니다.</p>
<h2 id="반응형-동작">반응형 동작<a class="anchor after" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="#반응형-동작"><span class="anchor-icon">#</span></a></h2>
<p>Svelte와 Vue의 가장 큰 차이는 반응형 동작 방식이라고 생각합니다.</p>
<p>Vue는 array 메서드(<code>push</code>, <code>pop</code>, <code>shift</code>, <code>unshift</code>, <code>splice</code>, <code>sort</code> 등)를 사용하면 반응형으로 화면이 갱신되지만, Svelte는 변수의 데이터 재할당이 일어나야 화면을 갱신합니다. 이런 특징으로 아래와 같이 작성된 Vue 코드는 아래와 같습니다. <a href="https://codepen.io/beomy/pen/XWmaMeW?editors=1010">CodePen</a>에서 확인할 수 있습니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> v-for</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"(obj, i) of arr"</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> :key</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"i"</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">span</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">        v-for</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"(inArr, j) of obj.inArr"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">        :key</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"j"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">        @click</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"addItem(obj.inArr)"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      ></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">        {{ inArr }}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      &#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">span</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    &#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  export</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492"> default</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">      data</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757"> () </span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">      return</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">        arr: [{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">          inArr: [</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">2</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">3</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">        }, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">          inArr: [</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">4</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">5</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">6</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">        }]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    }</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    methods: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">      addItem</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> (</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">inArr</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">        inArr.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">push</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(Math.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">max</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">...</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">inArr) </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">+</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> 1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span></code></pre>
<p>아래와 같은 Svelte 코드로 작성될 수 있습니다. <a href="https://svelte.dev/repl/e22314ca09624ce8bbdab46561f14005?version=3.55.1">Svelte REPL</a>에서 결과를 확인할 수 있습니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  let</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> arr </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">=</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> [{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    inArr: [</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">2</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">3</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    inArr: [</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">4</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">5</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">6</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  function</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF"> addItem</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">inArr</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    inArr.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">push</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(Math.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">max</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">...</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">inArr) </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">+</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> 1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    arr </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">=</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> arr</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">{#each arr as obj, i (i)}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    {#each obj.inArr as inArr, j (j)}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">span</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> on:click</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">{()</span><span style="color:#6E011A;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#FFB1AF;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic"> =</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">> addItem(obj.inArr)}>{inArr}&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">span</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    {/each}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">{/each}</span></span></code></pre>
<p><code>arr = arr</code>이라는 코드가 어색하다면 아래와 같이 작성할 수도 있습니다. 가장 왼쪽에 반응형으로 동작해야 하는 변수가 오면 됩니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  let</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> arr </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">=</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> [{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    inArr: [</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">2</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">3</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    inArr: [</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">4</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">5</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">6</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  function</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF"> addItem</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">i</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    arr[i].inArr </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">=</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> [</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">...</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">arr[i].inArr, Math.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">max</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">...</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">arr[i].inArr) </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">+</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> 1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">{#each arr as obj, i (i)}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    {#each obj.inArr as inArr, j (j)}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">span</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> on:click</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">{()</span><span style="color:#6E011A;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#FFB1AF;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic"> =</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">> addItem(i)}>{inArr}&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">span</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    {/each}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">{/each}</span></span></code></pre>
<p>Svelte는 변수의 데이터가 재할당 되어야 반응형이 동작하기 때문에 위에 코드와 같이 불필요한 코드를 추가해야 하는 불편함이 있습니다. Svelte를 처음 접한 사람이라면 <code>acc = acc</code>를 불필요한 코드로 보고 코드를 지울 수도 있어 보입니다.</p>
<h2 id="와-computed-차이"><code>$</code>와 <code>computed</code> 차이<a class="anchor after" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="#와-computed-차이"><span class="anchor-icon">#</span></a></h2>
<p><code>$</code> 문법은 Svelte의 독특한 문법입니다. <code>$</code> 문법은 Vue의 <code>computed</code>와 <code>watch</code>를 합쳐놓은 기능과 유사한데, <code>computed</code>보다는 <code>watch</code>에 가깝다고 생각이 듭니다. 아래 코드는 Vue의 <code>computed</code>를 사용한 예제입니다. <a href="https://codepen.io/beomy/pen/JjYJZbp">CodePen</a>에서 확인할 수 있습니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">button</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> @click</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"addNumber"</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">>추가&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">button</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    {{ multiple }}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  export</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492"> default</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">    data</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757"> () </span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">      return</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">        numbers: [</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">2</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">3</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    }</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    computed: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">      multiple</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> () {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">        return</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> this</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">.numbers.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">map</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">x</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492"> =></span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> x</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">*</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">2</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    }</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    methods: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">      addNumber</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> () {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">        this</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">.numbers.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">push</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">this</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">getRandomArbitrary</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">10</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">))</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">        console.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">log</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">this</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">.multiple)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">      getRandomArbitrary</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> (</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">min</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">max</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">        return</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> Math.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">floor</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(Math.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">random</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">() </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">*</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> (max </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">-</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> min) </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">+</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> min)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span></code></pre>
<p><img src="/assets/img/posts/svelte/vue_computed.gif" alt="Vue computed" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="342" height="239" srcset="/assets/img/posts/svelte/nextImageExportOptimizer/vue_computed-opt-640.WEBP 640w" sizes="(max-width: 640px) 100vw, 1000px"></p>
<p>위의 실행 결과 그림을 보면 HTML의 출력 결과와 Console 창의 출력 결과가 동일한 것을 볼 수 있습니다. 위의 코드의 <code>numbers</code>가 변경되면 즉시 <code>multiple</code>에도 반영됩니다. Svelte 코드로 아래와 같이 작성될 수 있습니다. <a href="https://svelte.dev/repl/aa8079cf26bc459880529f074c12f40a?version=3.55.1">Svelte REPL</a>에서 결과를 확인할 수 있습니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  let</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> numbers </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">=</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> [</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">2</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">3</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">  $</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">: multiple </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">=</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> numbers.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">map</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">x</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492"> =></span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> x</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">*</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">2</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  function</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF"> getRandomArbitrary</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">min</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">max</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">    return</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> Math.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">floor</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(Math.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">random</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">() </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">*</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> (max </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">-</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> min) </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">+</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> min)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  function</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF"> addNumber</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> () {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    numbers </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">=</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> [</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">...</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">numbers, </span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">getRandomArbitrary</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">1</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">, </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">10</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">)]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    console.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">log</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(multiple)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">button</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> on:click</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">{addNumber}</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">>추가&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">button</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">{multiple}</span></span></code></pre>
<p><img src="/assets/img/posts/svelte/svelte_$.gif" alt="Svelte $" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="264" height="295" srcset="/assets/img/posts/svelte/nextImageExportOptimizer/svelte_$-opt-640.WEBP 640w" sizes="(max-width: 640px) 100vw, 1000px"></p>
<p>Svelte에서 <code>numbers</code>가 변경되면 <code>$:</code> 부분의 코드인 <code>multiple</code> 변수에 <code>numbers</code>의 변경 값을 반영하는 코드가 실행됩니다. Svelte는 <code>numbers</code>가 변경되면 즉시 <code>multiple</code>에 반영되지 않습니다. 위의 실행 결과와 같이 HTML의 출력 결과와 Console 창의 출력 결과가 다르게 됩니다.</p>
<h2 id="사용되지-않은-css">사용되지 않은 CSS<a class="anchor after" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="#사용되지-않은-css"><span class="anchor-icon">#</span></a></h2>
<p>Svelte의 특징 중에 또 다른 하나는 <code>.svelte</code> 내에 사용하지 않는 스타일 있다면 컴파일 시 warning을 출력합니다. 그뿐만 아니라 사용되지 않는 스타일은 컴파일된 CSS 파일에 추가되지 않습니다. Svelte 문법을 사용하지 않고 순수 자바스크립트로 추가된 스타일을 사용하지 않은 스타일로 인식합니다. 예를 하나 살펴보겠습니다. (<a href="https://codepen.io/beomy/pen/mdewKGN">CodePen</a>에서 확인할 수 있습니다.)</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> id</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"app"</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> @click</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"toggleClass"</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    TOGGLE CLASS</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  export</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492"> default</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    methods: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">      toggleClass</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> () {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">        document.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">querySelector</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">'#app'</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">).classList.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">toggle</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">'active'</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">style</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  #app</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">    width</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">: </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">100</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">px</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">    height</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">: </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">100</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">px</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  .active</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">    background</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">: </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">blue</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">style</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span></code></pre>
<p><img src="/assets/img/posts/svelte/css_diff.gif" alt="CSS 차이" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="205" height="150" srcset="/assets/img/posts/svelte/nextImageExportOptimizer/css_diff-opt-640.WEBP 640w" sizes="(max-width: 640px) 100vw, 1000px"></p>
<p>자바스크립트를 사용하여 <code>active</code> 클래스가 토글 되는 예제입니다. Svelte 코드로 아래와 같이 작성할 수 있습니다. <a href="https://svelte.dev/repl/f50a3a0e9ca446f895c06c017164bc39?version=3.55.1">Svelte REPL</a>에서 결과를 확인할 수 있습니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  function</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF"> toggleClass</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> () {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    document.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">querySelector</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">'#app'</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">).classList.</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF">toggle</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">(</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">'active'</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> id</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"app"</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> on:click</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">{toggleClass}</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  TOGGLE CLASS</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">style</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  #app</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">    width</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">: </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">100</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">px</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">    height</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">: </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">100</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">px</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  .active</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">    background</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">: </span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">blue</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">style</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span></code></pre>
<p><img src="/assets/img/posts/svelte/svelte-css-remove.gif" alt="스타일이 적용 안됨" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="605" height="390" srcset="/assets/img/posts/svelte/nextImageExportOptimizer/svelte-css-remove-opt-640.WEBP 640w" sizes="(max-width: 640px) 100vw, 1000px"></p>
<p>위의 실행 결과를 보면 <code>active</code> 클래스는 추가되지만 스타일이 적용되지 않는 것을 볼 수 있습니다. 빌드 되어 생성된 <code>bundle.css</code> 파일을 살펴보면,</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="css"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">#app.svelte-1kepsqp</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">{</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">width</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">:</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">100</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">px</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">;</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">height</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">:</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">100</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">px</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#66707B;--shiki-dark:#BDC4CC">/*# sourceMappingURL=bundle.css.map */</span></span></code></pre>
<p><code>bundle.css</code>에서 <code>.active</code> 스타일이 존재하지 않는 것을 볼 수 있습니다. 이런 기능은 사용하지 않는 스타일이 제거되어 최적화에 도움이 됩니다. 위의 예제와 같이 사용될 수 있는 스타일의 경우 <code>public</code> 디렉터리 안에 <code>global.css</code>와 같은 별도의 CSS 파일에 정의해 주는 것이 좋습니다.</p>
<h2 id="여러-개의-최상위-요소">여러 개의 최상위 요소<a class="anchor after" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="#여러-개의-최상위-요소"><span class="anchor-icon">#</span></a></h2>
<p>Vue는 아래와 같이 <code>&#x3C;template></code> 안에 하나의 최상위 요소만 가질 수 있습니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    Vue는 하나의 최상위 요소만 가질 수 있습니다.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span></code></pre>
<p>이러한 특징은 컴포넌트를 분리할수록 DOM 트리가 깊어질 수 있으며, 이 특징을 고려하여 스타일이 작성되어야 합니다. 반면 Svelte는 제한 없이 여러 개의 최상위 요소를 가질 수 있습니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">>Svelte는&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">>여러 개의 최상위 요소를&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">>가질 수 있습니다.&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span></code></pre>
<h2 id="컴포넌트에-디렉티브-class-적용">컴포넌트에 디렉티브, class 적용<a class="anchor after" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="#컴포넌트에-디렉티브-class-적용"><span class="anchor-icon">#</span></a></h2>
<p>Vue는 아래와 같이 컴포넌트에 디렉티브 사용이 자유롭습니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#6E011A;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#FFB1AF;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">Child</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> v-custom-directive</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> /></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  import</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> Child </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">from</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF"> './Child'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  export</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492"> default</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    components: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      Child</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span></code></pre>
<p>뿐만 아니라 아래 코드와 같이 컴포넌트의 <code>class</code>와 <code>style</code>을
사용하는 방법도 편리합니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#6E011A;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#FFB1AF;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">Child</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> class</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"active"</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> style</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"margin:10px;"</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> /></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">template</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  import</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> Child </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">from</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF"> './Child'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  export</span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492"> default</span><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    components: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">      Child</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#702C00;--shiki-dark:#FFB757">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span></code></pre>
<p>하지만 Svelte는 컴포넌트에 <code>transition</code>, <code>animate</code>, <code>use</code> 등의 디렉티브를 사용할 수 없습니다. 이러한 디렉티브를 사용해야 할 경우 네이티브 태그를 사용하는 부모 요소에 사용해야 합니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  import</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> { fade } </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">from</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF"> 'svelte/transition'</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  import</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> { flip } </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">from</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF"> 'svelte/animate'</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  import</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> Child </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">from</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF"> './Child.svelte'</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  function</span><span style="color:#622CBC;--shiki-dark:#DBB7FF"> custom</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> () {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#66707B;--shiki-dark:#BDC4CC">&#x3C;!-- 아래와 같이 사용할 수 없습니다. --></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#6E011A;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#FFB1AF;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">Child</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  transition:fade</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  animate:flip</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"{{duration: 200}}"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  use:custom</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">/></span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#66707B;--shiki-dark:#BDC4CC">&#x3C;!-- 아래와 같은 방식으로 사용할 수 있습니다. --></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  transition:fade</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  animate:flip</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"{{duration: 200}}"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF">  use:custom</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">  &#x3C;</span><span style="color:#6E011A;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#FFB1AF;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">Child</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> /></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">div</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span></code></pre>
<p>또한 컴포넌트에 <code>class</code>와 <code>style</code>을 사용해도 적용되지 않습니다.</p>
<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-high-contrast github-dark-high-contrast" style="background-color:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0a0c10;color:#0e1116;--shiki-dark:#f0f3f6" tabindex="0" data-language="html"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">  import</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> Child </span><span style="color:#A0111F;--shiki-dark:#FF9492">from</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF"> './Child.svelte'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;/</span><span style="color:#024C1A;--shiki-dark:#72F088">script</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#66707B;--shiki-dark:#BDC4CC">&#x3C;!-- 아래와 같이 사용할 수 없습니다. --></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#6E011A;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#FFB1AF;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">Child</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> class</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"active"</span><span style="color:#023B95;--shiki-dark:#91CBFF"> style</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6">=</span><span style="color:#032563;--shiki-dark:#ADDCFF">"margin: 10px;"</span><span style="color:#0E1116;--shiki-dark:#F0F3F6"> /></span></span></code></pre>
<p>위의 같이 작성되었다면, <code>Child</code> 컴포넌트에서 <code>class</code>와 <code>style</code>를 props로 전달받아 별도의 처리를 해주어야 합니다. 심지어 <code>class</code>는 예약어이기 때문에 <code>className</code>과 같은 예약어와 겹치지 않는 이름을 사용해야 합니다.</p>f:X
